title: Finding the Music at a Street Festival
title_zh: 在街头节庆寻找音乐表演
context: Lena 和 Marco 到街头节庆看演出，先确认舞台位置，再商量碰头地点。 本课属于 2026-11-22 预制系列，练习题为原创练习，并非真实考试题。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: The street festival is busier than I expected. Can you see the music stage?
dialogue.zh: 街头节庆比我想的热闹。你能看到音乐舞台吗？

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: Not from here. The map shows it beyond the art stalls.
dialogue.zh: 从这里看不到。地图显示它在艺术摊位那边。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: The next band starts soon, so let us head that way.
dialogue.zh: 下一支乐队很快就要开始了，我们往那边走吧。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: Good idea. Do you want to stop at the craft booth first?
dialogue.zh: 好主意。你想先去手工摊看看吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Maybe afterward. I don't want to miss the first song.
dialogue.zh: 也许演出后吧。我不想错过第一首歌。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: That makes sense. People are moving slowly around the corner.
dialogue.zh: 有道理。拐角附近的人走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: If we get separated, let us meet by the blue information tent.
dialogue.zh: 如果我们走散了，就在蓝色服务帐篷旁碰头吧。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: I can see it from here. I will take a picture so I remember.
dialogue.zh: 我从这里能看到。我拍张照，免得忘了。

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Look, the stage is just past that painted sign.
dialogue.zh: 看，舞台就在那块彩绘指示牌过去一点。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: And there is room to stand near the back. Can you see from there?
dialogue.zh: 后面附近有地方站。你从那里能看见吗？

dialogue.speaker: Lena
dialogue.en: Yes, and we can hear the music without being too close.
dialogue.zh: 能，而且不用靠得太近就能听到音乐。

dialogue.speaker: Marco
dialogue.en: Perfect. Let's enjoy the band and visit the booths later.
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我们先欣赏乐队，待会儿再逛摊位。

expressions.example: The entrance is ahead, so let us head that way.

expressions.zh: 错过第一首歌；miss 可表示错过活动。
expressions.example: We left early so we would not miss the first song.
We got separated in the crowd.
The cafe is just past the bookstore.
We found two seats near the back.

pronunciation: festival 的重音在第一个音节；stage 结尾是 /dʒ/，与 age 的结尾相同。

practice.title: Part 1 · Festivals
practice.answer: Yes, especially when there is live music. I like walking around and seeing what local artists have made.

practice.title: Part 2 · A public event
practice.prompt: Describe a public event you enjoyed. Say where it was, what you did there, and why you remember it.
practice.answer: I went to a street festival with a friend last summer. We followed a map to a small stage and listened to a local band. After the music, we looked at handmade bowls and posters at the nearby booths. The street was crowded, but everyone seemed cheerful. I remember singing along to a song I already knew and laughing with my friend. 这是入门短答，请补充个人经历并扩展到接近两分钟。

practice.title: Part 3 · Local events
practice.prompt: How can local festivals bring people together?
practice.answer: Festivals give residents a reason to share a public space and discover local artists. Clear signs and accessible routes can also help more people take part.

practice.title: 跟读与口头练习
practice.prompt: 跟读问路和约定碰头地点的句子，再描述你想看的演出。
practice.answer: Where is the music stage? Let us meet by the information tent if we get separated. We can visit the craft booths afterward.
